context.transcript:
Can I have your attention please everyone?
We will begin producing the next generation of our best-selling car model next quarter.
We have already received all the parts we need so we can start the assembly process in July.
As supervisors, you will have to reassign some tasks for your workers. you'll have to reassign some tasks for your workers on the factory floor.
I'll be emailing you information on production targets and timelines to help you do that.
Thank you for your cooperation.
context.transcript_translation:
请大家注意一下？
我们将在下个季度开始生产下一代畅销车型。
我们已经收到了所有需要的零件，所以我们可以在七月开始组装流程了。
作为主管，你们必须重新分配一些任务给你们的工人。你们必须在工厂车间为你们的工人们重新分配一些任务。
我会给你们发送关于生产目标和时间表的邮件，帮助你们做到这一点。
感谢您的配合。
